court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. A. Kannan Party in person
For Respondents: Mr. A.K. Baskara Pandian Special Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the second respondent herein to grant Arms License (Pistol) to the petitioner for his personal protection of life and liberty in accordance with Section 13(3)(b)(iii) Chapter-III of Arms Act, 1959 and the Rules made therein, based on the application of the petitioner, dated 26.06.2015 within a time frame fixed by this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.S. Sundar, J.:— The petitioner, who appeared before this Court as party in person, submitted that the Writ Petition may be dismissed as withdrawn, as the relief sought for has already been granted. The petitioner has also made an endorsement to that effect. Recording the same, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
